newsitem.title: FRANCE: GEC Alsthom wins FRF 160 mln Korean order.
newsitem.headline: GEC Alsthom wins FRF 160 mln Korean order.

text.p: GEC Alsthom said on Tuesday it had won a 25 million ecu, or 160 million franc, order to supply Daewoo Heavy Industries with 100 electric traction systems for South Korea's Inchon metro.

The order is for trains operating on Inchon's line one and includes the supply of propulsion machinery, auxiliary converters and on-board information systems. Delivery will begin in June 1997 and is scheduled for completion in 1998.
GEC Alsthom is the leading supplier of metro traction equipment to South Korea, having won orders for over 500 traction systems in the last five years.
GEC Alsthom NV is a joint venture of France's Alcatel Alsthom and Britain's General Electric Plc.
